facts.fact: 拍品 Lot 5 是 1969 年 Wiltshire 郡 Rushwood 的手绘地图：墨笔加水彩，画在 A2 卡纸上。
facts.anchor: Lot 5: Hand-drawn map of Rushwood, Wiltshire, 1969. Ink pen and watercolour on A2 card.

facts.fact: 入口大厅挂着一张六英尺的装框官制大地图（透过大窗可见、夜间点亮），画图人注意到它省略了劳作区。
facts.anchor: grand, framed six-foot map of Rushwood’s house and grounds that hung in the entrance hall

facts.fact: 她的版本补上了园头小屋（箭头标注 Unfortunately, you are here）、户外厕所、洗衣房、厨师后厨房等劳作处所，乃至棕榈房与堆肥堆。
facts.anchor: adding the head gardener’s cottage (arrowed: ‘Unfortunately, you are here’), the outdoor privy, the laundry room

facts.fact: 图上散布的 X 标记在图例里各有解释，其中两处名为 The Saving 与 Beware – Harold roams here。
facts.anchor: The marked Xs scattered across the ground are explained in the key, among them ‘The Saving’ and ‘Beware – Harold roams here’.

facts.fact: Mimi 的拼写错误 unfortutly 被她的姐妹 Pamela 改正，Pamela 还在右下角留下一枚泥手指印。
facts.anchor: Mimi’s misspelling – ‘unfortutly [sic] – was corrected by her sister Pamela, who also left a muddy fingerprint at the bottom right.

facts.fact: Pamela 怕这张地图给她们俩惹上麻烦，想抢过来毁掉它，但 Mimi 紧抓不放。
facts.anchor: Fearing the map might get them into trouble, Pamela tried to snatch it and destroy it, but Mimi held fast.
